items.reason: The shared pointer does reach hooks through pkg/api/index.go:137 and :159, but the only registered hook modifies NavTree, not Assets (pkg/services/licensing/oss.go:57-71). Asset URL mutation occurs before cache publication (pkg/api/webassets/webassets.go:64-69), so no concurrent asset mutation is demonstrated. The base already returned the same cached pointer; this PR adds synchronization without introducing the alleged mutation path.
